items.title: The Death of the Traditional OOH Middleman: Will AI Agents Reshape OOH Buying by 2030?
items.topic: What happens when AI agents can discover inventory, plan campaigns, compare prices, negotiate deals, and optimize performance with minimal human intervention?  The OOH and DOOH ecosystem could be heading towards a fundamental shift. The real question is not simply whether AI will replace intermediaries, but who will control the buying process in the next era of advertising?
